caption: The batteries are pulled out of a walking toy robot, and the robot stops mid-step.

sa.check: The order is walking, batteries out, stopped.

pc.expect: The robot's movement and any lights stop at the moment the batteries come out, and only then.
pc.fail: The batteries are out and the robot walks on; or the robot stops before the batteries move; or the robot's lights stay lit with the batteries out; or the robot finishes its step and takes another with the batteries out.

pc.expect: Once stopped the robot stays frozen in its pose and does not move again while the batteries are out.
pc.fail: The robot moves again with the batteries out; or twitches or rocks by itself; or its arms or head move after the stop; or the robot walks before the batteries were in.

pc.expect: The stopped robot stands on the surface or falls over if off balance; the removed batteries are held or fall to the surface.
pc.fail: The robot hangs in mid-step with a foot in the air and does not settle; or the robot floats; or a dropped battery rises or hangs in the air.

pc.expect: While walking the robot moves forward in the direction it faces, its feet lifting and landing in turn.
pc.fail: The robot slides without moving its legs; or moves sideways to its facing; or its feet pass through the floor; or it lifts off the floor as it walks.

pc.expect: One robot with its limbs attached; the batteries come out of an opening; nothing vanishes or passes through the robot's body.
pc.fail: The batteries pass through the robot's shell; or a limb detaches; or a second robot appears; or the batteries vanish in the hand.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The robot's colours and markings and the surface stay the same apart from the lights.
pc.fail: The robot changes colour; or its markings change; or the surface changes.

note: The robot is a powered toy; its walking before the batteries come out is the caption's setup and is not judged for gait.
